title: Taylor Swift Drops New Insect Species - Nautilus
gist: A UC Riverside doctoral student named a new genus of Australian plant bugs Swiftiephylus after Taylor Swift, her first honorary genus name, citing the insects' pale yellow and red coloring.

insights.claim: Taylor Swift received her first honorary genus name, Swiftiephylus, for a newly described group of insects.
insights.speaker: Devin Reese
insights.so_what: Illustrates Swift's cultural reach; celebrity naming drives outsized media attention for otherwise obscure science.
